question.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trajectory.tracking;
SELECT title FROM imdb.movies ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM imdb.movies WHERE movieid IN (SELECT movieid FROM imdb.movies2directors GROUP BY movieid HAVING COUNT(directorid) > 7);
SELECT year FROM imdb.movies WHERE movieid = (SELECT movieid FROM imdb.movies2directors GROUP BY movieid ORDER BY COUNT(directorid) DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT a.actorid FROM imdb.movies2actors r2 JOIN imdb.actors a ON r2.actorid = a.actorid WHERE r2.movieid IN ( SELECT movieid FROM imdb.movies2actors WHERE actorid = (SELECT actorid FROM imdb.actors WHERE name = 'Hanks, Tom') ) AND r2.actorid <> (SELECT actorid FROM imdb.actors WHERE name = 'Hanks, Tom') GROUP BY a.actorid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT r1.actorid AS actor1, r2.actorid AS actor2, COUNT(*) AS movie_count FROM imdb.movies2actors r1 JOIN imdb.movies2actors r2 USING (movieid) WHERE r1.actorid <> r2.actorid GROUP BY r1.actorid, r2.actorid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ) AS actor_pairs;

SELECT FLOOR(year / 10) * 10 AS decade FROM imdb.movies m JOIN imdb.ratings r ON m.movieid = r.movieid GROUP BY decade ORDER BY AVG(CAST(r.rank AS FLOAT)) DESC LIMIT 1; 7)14 SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT movieid) FROM imdb.movies2directors WHERE genre IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM imdb.movies m JOIN imdb.movies2writers w ON m.movieid = w.movieid JOIN imdb.movies2directors d ON m.movieid = d.movieid WHERE w.writerid = d.directorid AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM imdb.movies2actors a WHERE a.movieid = m.movieid AND a.actorid = w.writerid );

SELECT d.directorid FROM imdb.movies2directors d JOIN imdb.movies m ON d.movieid = m.movieid JOIN imdb.runningtimes r ON m.movieid = r.movieid WHERE r.time1 > 160 GROUP BY d.directorid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.actorid FROM imdb.actors a JOIN imdb.movies2actors ma ON a.actorid = ma.actorid JOIN imdb.movies m ON ma.movieid = m.movieid WHERE m.year < 2015 GROUP BY a.actorid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.movieid) > 43 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM imdb.movies2directors md JOIN imdb.directors d ON md.directorid = d.directorid JOIN imdb.movies2actors ma2 ON md.movieid = ma2.movieid -- Ensure filtering by actor's movies WHERE d.name = 'Spielberg, Steven' AND ma2.actorid = a.actorid -- Match actor's ID correctly );
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenicornot.locations WHERE ST_DWithin( geom_bng::geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(530000, 180000), 27700)::geometry, 5000 );

SELECT h.cell_id FROM scenicornot.locations l JOIN scenicornot.hexgrid10km h ON ST_Contains(h.geom::geometry, l.geom_bng::geometry) GROUP BY h.cell_id HAVING COUNT(l.id) >= 3 ORDER BY AVG(l.average) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(vote::BIGINT) AS total_votes FROM scenicornot.locations l JOIN scenicornot.hexgrid10km h ON ST_Contains(h.geom::geometry, l.geom_bng::geometry), LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(l.votes, ',')) AS vote GROUP BY h.cell_id ORDER BY total_votes DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH avg_scores AS ( SELECT h.cell_id, h.geom, AVG(l.average) AS avg_score -- Include h.geom FROM scenicornot.locations l JOIN scenicornot.hexgrid10km h ON ST_Contains(h.geom::geometry, l.geom_bng::geometry) GROUP BY h.cell_id, h.geom -- Also group by h.geom ) SELECT a.cell_id AS cell_1, b.cell_id AS cell_2 FROM avg_scores a JOIN avg_scores b ON ST_Touches(a.geom::geometry, b.geom::geometry) ORDER BY ABS(a.avg_score - b.avg_score) DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH quake_counts AS ( SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (datetime - '2010-01-01 00:00:00')) / (48 * 3600)) AS period, COUNT(*) AS quake_count FROM quakes.scotquakes GROUP BY period ), max_count AS ( SELECT MAX(quake_count) AS max_quakes FROM quake_counts ) SELECT TO_CHAR('2010-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp + (q.period * INTERVAL '48 hours'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS start_time, TO_CHAR('2010-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp + ((q.period + 1) * INTERVAL '48 hours'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS end_time FROM quake_counts q JOIN max_count m ON q.quake_count = m.max_quakes;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.fid) AS location_count FROM scenicornot.locations l JOIN quakes.scotquakes q ON ST_DWithin( l.geom_bng::geometry, ST_Transform(q.geom, 27700)::geometry, -- Convert quakes to British National Grid 100 -- Distance in meters );

WITH clusters AS ( SELECT ST_ClusterDBSCAN(geom::geometry, eps := 15000, minpoints := 5) OVER () AS cluster_id FROM quakes.scotquakes ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cluster_id) AS total_clusters FROM clusters WHERE cluster_id IS NOT NULL;

WITH route_stats AS ( SELECT userid, ST_Length(ST_MakeLine(geom ORDER BY tm)) AS total_distance, ST_Distance(ST_StartPoint(ST_MakeLine(geom ORDER BY tm)), ST_EndPoint(ST_MakeLine(geom ORDER BY tm))) AS straight_line_distance FROM trajectory.tracking GROUP BY userid ) SELECT userid FROM route_stats ORDER BY (straight_line_distance / total_distance) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(distance) AS total_distance_m FROM ( SELECT tm, -- Include timestamp for ordering ST_Distance(geom, LAG(geom) OVER (ORDER BY tm)) AS distance FROM ( SELECT tm, -- Include timestamp in the subquery ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(lng, lat), 4326), 3857) AS geom FROM trajectory.tracking WHERE userid = 'p1' ) AS transformed_points ) AS distances WHERE distance IS NOT NULL;
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_taken) AS photo_month FROM flickr.flickr_edin GROUP BY photo_month ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.userid FROM flickr.flickr_edin AS f JOIN flickr.grid100m AS g ON ST_Contains(g.geom, f.geom) -- Check if the photo's location falls within the grid cell GROUP BY f.userid ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT g.id) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS avenue_count FROM ( SELECT osm_name FROM accident.network WHERE osm_name ILIKE '%avenue%' -- Case-insensitive match for 'avenue' GROUP BY osm_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT osm_id) > 1 ) AS subquery;

WITH crashes_per_route AS ( SELECT 'route_a' AS route_name, COUNT(ec.id) AS crash_count, ST_Length(ra.geom) / 1000 AS route_length_km -- Convert route length to kilometers FROM accident.edincrash ec JOIN accident.route_a ra ON ST_DWithin(ec.geom, ra.geom, 15) -- Check if crashes are within 15 meters of the route GROUP BY ra.geom
UNION ALL
SELECT 'route_b' AS route_name, COUNT(ec.id) AS crash_count, ST_Length(rb.geom) / 1000 AS route_length_km FROM accident.edincrash ec JOIN accident.route_b rb ON ST_DWithin(ec.geom, rb.geom, 15) GROUP BY rb.geom
UNION ALL
SELECT 'route_c' AS route_name, COUNT(ec.id) AS crash_count, ST_Length(rc.geom) / 1000 AS route_length_km FROM accident.edincrash ec JOIN accident.route_c rc ON ST_DWithin(ec.geom, rc.geom, 15) GROUP BY rc.geom ) SELECT route_name FROM crashes_per_route ORDER BY crash_count / route_length_km DESC LIMIT 1; -- Return only the most dangerous route's name
